title: Q7
description:
“For he waited for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.”
Read: Gen 12:7, Gen 13:14–17, Gen 15:18–21, Psa 87:1–3, Isa 54:11–12
a) The promise to Abraham was land. Psalms and Isaiah speak of Zion founded by Yahweh. What do these bring forward that lets Hebrews speak of a city without cancelling the land?
